IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.en:
BEGIN_H3Debugging FeaturesEND_H3
          BR
          You can enable the debugging features on your NickelOS device in order to install and test custom code on your device.  This will allow you to:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEMRemove rootfs verification so you can modify OS files
            LIST_ITEMEnable SSH access to the device using the standard test keys so you can use tools such as BEGIN_CODE'cros flash'END_CODE to access the device
            LIST_ITEMEnable booting from USB so you can install an OS image from a USB drive
            LIST_ITEMSet both the dev and the system root login password to a custom value so you can manually SSH into the device
          END_LIST
          BR
          Once enabled, most of the debugging features will remain enabled even after performing a powerwash or wiping the data on an enterprise managed device.  To fully disable all debugging features, reinstall NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          For more information about the debugging features see:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDNote:END_BOLD  The system will reboot during the process.
IDS_ENABLE_DEBUGGING_HELP.t:
BEGIN_H3Funkcije za odpravljanje napakEND_H3
          BR
          Če želite v napravi s sistemom NickelOS namestiti in preizkusiti kodo po meri, lahko v njej omogočite funkcije za odpravljanje napak. S tem boste lahko:BR
          BEGIN_LIST
            LIST_ITEModstranili preverjanje »rootfs«, tako da boste lahko spreminjali datoteke operacijskega sistema;
            LIST_ITEMomogočili dostop do naprave s protokolom SSH s standardnimi preizkusnimi ključi, tako da boste lahko za dostop do naprave uporabljali orodja, kot je BEGIN_CODE»cros flash«END_CODE;
            LIST_ITEMomogočili zaganjanje s pogona USB, tako da boste lahko namestili sliko operacijskega sistema s pogona USB;
            LIST_ITEMnastavili geslo za prijavo v razvijalski kanal in sistemsko korensko geslo na vrednost po meri, tako da boste imeli na voljo ročni dostop do naprave s protokolom SSH;
          END_LIST
          BR
          Ko so funkcije za odpravljanje napak omogočene, jih bo večina ostala omogočena tudi po izvedbi funkcije Powerwash ali brisanju podatkov v napravi, ki jo upravljajo v podjetju. Če želite v celoti onemogočiti vse funkcije za odpravljanje napak, znova namestite NickelOS.
          BR
          BR
          Če želite več informacij o funkcijah za odpravljanje napak, glejte:BR
          https://www.chromium.org/chromium-os/how-tos-and-troubleshooting/debugging-features
          BR
          BR
          BEGIN_BOLDOpomba:END_BOLD Sistem se bo med postopkom znova zagnal.

IDS_NICKEL_CAMERA_ACCESS_TITLE.t: Želite aplikaciji APP_NAME dovoliti uporabo kamere?

IDS_NICKEL_CAMERA_OFF_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to use the camera. To let it, turn on camera access in Privacy controls.
IDS_NICKEL_CAMERA_OFF_MESSAGE.t: Aplikacija APP_NAME želi uporabljati kamero. Če ji to želite dovoliti, vklopite dostop do kamere v kontrolnikih zasebnosti.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_HINT.en: To change a shortcut, select its keys and press new ones. Backspace removes it.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_HINT.t: Če želite spremeniti bližnjico, izberite njene tipke in pritisnite nove. Z vračalko jo odstranite.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants these shortcuts to work while you use other apps too. It learns only when you press them, not what else you type.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_MESSAGE.t: Aplikacija APP_NAME želi, da te bližnjice delujejo tudi, ko uporabljate druge aplikacije. Izve samo, kdaj jih pritisnete, ne pa, kaj drugega tipkate.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_NEEDS_MODIFI.en: Use Ctrl, Alt or Search with the key, or a function key.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_NEEDS_MODIFI.t: Tipko uporabite skupaj s Ctrl, Alt ali tipko za iskanje oziroma uporabite funkcijsko tipko.

IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TAKEN.en: Those keys are already in use. Try others.
IDS_NICKEL_GLOBAL_SHORTCUTS_TAKEN.t: Te tipke so že v uporabi. Poskusite druge.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_FAILED_DE.en: Could not create the account: DETAIL.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_FAILED_DE.t: Računa ni bilo mogoče ustvariti: DETAIL.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_SIGN_IN.en: Could not set up the account: DETAIL
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_SIGN_IN.t: Računa ni bilo mogoče nastaviti: DETAIL

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TAKEN.t: To uporabniško ime je že zasedeno.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.en: Creating the account took too long. Try again.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_TOO_LONG.t: Ustvarjanje računa je trajalo predolgo. Poskusite znova.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.en: Usernames start with a lowercase letter and use only lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32).
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_ERROR_USERNAME.t: Uporabniška imena se začnejo z malo črko in vsebujejo samo male črke, števke, - in _ (največ 32 znakov).

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.en: It shows on the sign-in screen and in the system tray. To use a photo of your own, go to Settings later.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_PICTURE_SUBTITL.t: Prikazana je na zaslonu za prijavo in v sistemski vrstici. Če želite uporabiti svojo fotografijo, pozneje odprite nastavitve.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.en: Your account and its files live on this device, encrypted with your password. Without a Google account there is no way to recover them if you forget it.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_SUBTITLE.t: Vaš račun in njegove datoteke so shranjeni v tej napravi in šifrirani z vašim geslom. Brez računa Google jih ni mogoče obnoviti, če pozabite geslo.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.en: Start with a lowercase letter; use lowercase letters, digits, - and _ (up to 32)
IDS_NICKEL_LOCAL_ACCOUNT_USERNAME_ERROR.t: Začnite z malo črko; uporabite male črke, števke, - in _ (največ 32)

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to know where this device is, found from nearby Wi-Fi networks and its internet address. Your answer is remembered for this app.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_MESSAGE.t: Aplikacija APP_NAME želi vedeti, kje je ta naprava, kar ugotovi iz bližnjih omrežij Wi-Fi in njenega internetnega naslova. Vaš odgovor bo za to aplikacijo shranjen.

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.en: Allow APP_NAME to use your location?
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_ACCESS_TITLE.t: Želite aplikaciji APP_NAME dovoliti uporabo vaše lokacije?

IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to use your location. To let it, turn on location access in Privacy controls.
IDS_NICKEL_LOCATION_OFF_MESSAGE.t: Aplikacija APP_NAME želi uporabljati vašo lokacijo. Če ji to želite dovoliti, vklopite dostop do lokacije v kontrolnikih zasebnosti.

IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.en: APP_NAME wants to control this device's keyboard and pointer. Allow it only if you trust whoever is connecting.
IDS_NICKEL_REMOTE_CONTROL_MESSAGE.t: Aplikacija APP_NAME želi nadzirati tipkovnico in kazalec te naprave. Dovolite to samo, če zaupate osebi, ki se povezuje.

IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.en: You chose Minimal when you set up NickelOS, so no search engine was picked for you. These search engines are popular in your region and are shown in random order.
IDS_NICKEL_SEARCH_ENGINE_CHOICE_INFO_DIA.t: Pri nastavitvi sistema NickelOS ste izbrali možnost »Minimalno«, zato iskalnik ni bil izbran namesto vas. Ti iskalniki so priljubljeni v vaši regiji in so prikazani v naključnem vrstnem redu.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.en: Either way, you get Bazaar to find more apps, and apps to open your photos, videos, music and documents.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_EITHER_WAY.t: V obeh primerih dobite trgovino Bazaar za iskanje novih aplikacij ter aplikacije za odpiranje fotografij, videoposnetkov, glasbe in dokumentov.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.en: Everything ready to go, and private. DuckDuckGo searches the web from the browser and the launcher, uBlock Origin blocks ads and trackers in the browser, Proton's private apps (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass and more) are installed, and free, open-source apps come with it: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive and more.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_FULL_DESCRIPTION.t: Vse pripravljeno za uporabo in zasebno. DuckDuckGo išče po spletu iz brskalnika in zaganjalnika, uBlock Origin v brskalniku blokira oglase in sledilnike, nameščene so zasebne aplikacije podjetja Proton (Mail, Calendar, Drive, Pass in druge), priložene pa so tudi brezplačne odprtokodne aplikacije: LibreOffice, OBS Studio, GIMP, Kdenlive in druge.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.en: Just the basics. The launcher searches only this computer, and nothing else is set up for you.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_MINIMAL_DESCRIPTION.t: Samo osnove. Zaganjalnik išče samo po tem računalniku in nič drugega ni nastavljeno namesto vas.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.en: You can change all of this later in Settings.
IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_SUBTITLE.t: Vse to lahko pozneje spremenite v nastavitvah.

IDS_NICKEL_SETUP_TITLE.en: How would you like to start?

IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.en: Personalize your accessibility tools in NickelOS settings
IDS_OMNIBOX_PEDAL_MANAGE_CHROMEOS_ACCESS.t: Osebno prilagajanje orodij za ljudi s posebnimi potrebami v nastavitvah sistema NickelOS.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press the space bar.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Ali želite aktivirati ChromeVox, vgrajeni bralnik zaslona za NickelOS? Če ga želite, pritisnite preslednico.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS? If so, press and hold both volume keys for five seconds.
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_ANNOUNCEMENT_TEX.t: Ali želite aktivirati ChromeVox, vgrajeni bralnik zaslona za NickelOS? Če ga želite, za pet sekund pridržite gumba za glasnost.

IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.en: Do you want to activate ChromeVox, the built-in screen reader for NickelOS?
IDS_OOBE_CHROMEVOX_HINT_TEXT.t: Ali želite aktivirati ChromeVox, vgrajeni bralnik zaslona za NickelOS?

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.en: Before starting, make sure you have a backup of your data. Installing DEVICE_OS will overwrite the disk you choose.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_CONTENT_0.t: Preden začnete, morate varnostno kopirati podatke. Z namestitvijo sistema DEVICE_OS bodo prepisani vsi podatki na izbranem disku.

IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.en: DEVICE_OS is free software provided as is: it may not work on every computer, and its authors are not responsible for any data loss.
IDS_OS_INSTALL_SCREEN_INTRO_FOOTER.t: Sistem DEVICE_OS je prosta programska oprema, ki je na voljo takšna, kot je: morda ne bo deloval v vseh računalnikih, njegovi avtorji pa niso odgovorni za kakršno koli izgubo podatkov.

IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.en: Your apps and settings will sync across all NickelOS devices where you are signed in with your Google account. For browser sync options, go to LINK_BEGINChrome settingsLINK_END.
IDS_OS_SETTINGS_SYNC_FEATURE_LABEL.t: Vaše aplikacije in nastavitve se bodo sinhronizirale v vseh napravah s sistemom NickelOS, v katerih ste prijavljeni z računom Google. Če vas zanimajo možnosti sinhronizacije brskalnika, odprite LINK_BEGINChromove nastavitveLINK_END.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: When your screen is idle, show your pictures, time, and media info
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Ko je zaslon nedejaven, prikaži svoje slike, uro in podatke o predstavnosti

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows the pictures in your Pictures folder and the folders in it. Add at least 2.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Ohranjevalnik zaslona prikazuje slike v mapi Slike in njenih podmapah. Dodajte vsaj 2.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: The screen saver shows NickelOS's wallpapers. Turn this on to show the pictures in My files > Pictures instead.
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Ohranjevalnik zaslona prikazuje ozadja sistema NickelOS. To možnost vklopite, če želite namesto njih prikazovati slike iz mape Moje datoteke > Pictures.

IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.en: From Open-Meteo, for your approximate location, which beaconDB works out from your internet address
IDS_PERSONALIZATION_APP_AMBIENT_MODE_NIC.t: Iz storitve Open-Meteo za vašo približno lokacijo, ki jo beaconDB določi na podlagi vašega naslova IP

IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.en: Make sure your printer is turned on and connected to the same network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable
IDS_PRINT_PREVIEW_PRINTER_SETUP_INFO_MES.t: Poskrbite, da je tiskalnik vklopljen in povezan v isto omrežje kot naprava s sistemom NickelOS, ali uporabite kabel USB

IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.en: When on, data is saved in your Google Account and can be used on all your devices. When off, data is saved only to this device. For NickelOS sync options, go to LINK_BEGINNickelOS settingsLINK_END.
IDS_SETTINGS_ACCOUNT_BODY_CHROMEOS.t: Če je vklopljeno, se podatki shranjujejo v računu Google in jih je mogoče uporabljati v vseh vaših napravah. Če je izklopljeno, se podatki shranjujejo samo v tej napravi. Za možnosti sinhronizacije v sistemu NickelOS odprite LINK_BEGINnastavitve sistema NickelOSLINK_END.

IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device. Permission will be requested each time you plug in a USB device. Individual Android apps will ask for additional permissions.
IDS_SETTINGS_APPS_ARC_VM_SHARED_USB_DEVI.t: Aplikacijam za Android omogočite nadzor nad napravami USB v tej napravi s sistemom NickelOS. Dovoljenje bo zahtevano vsakič, ko priključite napravo USB. Posamezne aplikacije za Android bodo zahtevale dodatna dovoljenja.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Vaša naprava ne prejema več varnostnih posodobitev in posodobitev programske opreme.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_NO_OF.t: Ta naprava ne prejema več posodobitev

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: Your device is no longer receiving security and software updates.
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Vaša naprava ne prejema več varnostnih posodobitev in posodobitev programske opreme.

IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.en: This device no longer gets updates
IDS_SETTINGS_END_OF_LIFE_INCENTIVE_OFFER.t: Ta naprava ne prejema več posodobitev

IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.en: Give Android apps control over USB devices on this NickelOS device
IDS_SETTINGS_GUEST_OS_SHARED_USB_DEVICES.t: Aplikacijam za Android omogočite nadzor nad napravami USB v tej napravi s sistemom NickelOS

IDS_SETTINGS_LANGUAGES_OPEN_CHROME_OS_SE.t: Upravljanje jezikov v nastavitvah sistema NickelOS

IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.en: This option applies to NickelOS devices with a data plan or mobile network dongle, or when tethering to a portable hotspot
IDS_SETTINGS_NEARBY_SHARE_DATA_USAGE_MOB.t: Ta možnost velja za naprave s sistemom NickelOS s podatkovnim paketom ali ključkom za mobilno omrežje oziroma za tiste, ki imajo povezavo s prenosno dostopno točko vzpostavljeno z internetom prek mobilnega telefona.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.en: You'll be signed out. On the sign-in screen, the new person chooses a name, a username and a password.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADD_PERSON_.t: Odjavljeni boste. Nova oseba na zaslonu za prijavo izbere ime, uporabniško ime in geslo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.en: Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_ADMIN_BODY.t: Skrbniki lahko nameščajo programsko opremo za vse, spreminjajo sistem in upravljajo račune.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_FAILED.t: Prišlo je do napake. Poskusite znova.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.en: This device needs at least one administrator
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_LAST_ADMIN.t: Ta naprava potrebuje vsaj enega skrbnika

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_MAKE_ADMIN_.t: Želite uporabnika NAME nastaviti za skrbnika?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.en: No one else has an account on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_NO_OTHER_PE.t: Nihče drug nima računa v tej napravi.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.en: Everyone has their own account and files. Administrators can install software for everyone, change the system and manage accounts.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_OTHER_PEOPL.t: Vsak ima svoj račun in datoteke. Skrbniki lahko nameščajo programsko opremo za vse, spreminjajo sistem in upravljajo račune.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_ADMI.t: Želite uporabnika NAME nastaviti za standardnega uporabnika?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.en: Their account and all their files are deleted from this device. This can't be undone.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ACCOUNTS_REMOVE_BODY.t: Račun te osebe in vse njene datoteke bodo izbrisani iz te naprave. Tega ni mogoče razveljaviti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.en: Only an administrator of this device can change these.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ADMIN_ONLY.t: Te nastavitve lahko spremeni samo skrbnik te naprave.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.en: For apps built only for the ARM processors phones use, many games among them. Proprietary software, downloaded when you turn it on.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DESCRIPT.t: Za aplikacije, izdelane samo za procesorje ARM, ki jih uporabljajo telefoni – med njimi je veliko iger. Lastniška programska oprema, ki se prenese, ko to vklopite.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: Many Android apps, games especially, are built only for the ARM processors phones use. To run them on this computer, Android needs a translator. NickelOS doesn't make or include one: turning this on downloads TRANSLATOR from GitHub, the same copy the Waydroid community's waydroid_script installs.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: Veliko aplikacij za Android, zlasti iger, je izdelanih samo za procesorje ARM, ki jih uporabljajo telefoni. Če jih želite izvajati v tem računalniku, Android potrebuje prevajalnik. NickelOS ga ne izdeluje in ne vključuje: z vklopom te možnosti se iz storitve GitHub prenese TRANSLATOR, enaka kopija, kot jo namesti skript waydroid_script skupnosti Waydroid.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.en: It's proprietary software, under its owner's terms, and you're the one installing it. Some apps may run slowly or not at all. Android restarts to use it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_B.t: To je lastniška programska oprema, za katero veljajo pogoji njenega lastnika, namestite pa jo vi. Nekatere aplikacije morda delujejo počasi ali sploh ne. Android se znova zažene, da jo lahko uporablja.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ARM_DIALOG_T.t: Želite vklopiti podporo za aplikacije ARM?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.en: The download didn't finish. Check your connection, then try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_DOWNLO.t: Prenos ni bil dokončan. Preverite povezavo in poskusite znova.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_ERROR_FAILED.t: Prišlo je do napake. Poskusite znova.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.en: Deletes Android, your Android apps and their data
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DESCR.t: Izbriše sistem Android, vaše aplikacije za Android in njihove podatke

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.en: Android, your Android apps and their data are deleted from this device. Other people who use it keep their Android data, but can't open their Android apps until Android is set up again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_REMOVE_DIALO.t: Sistem Android, vaše aplikacije za Android in njihovi podatki bodo izbrisani iz te naprave. Drugi uporabniki naprave obdržijo svoje podatke sistema Android, vendar ne morejo odpreti svojih aplikacij za Android, dokler sistem Android ni znova nastavljen.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.en: Android apps open in their own windows, next to your other apps. Setting up downloads Android (LineageOS, from the Waydroid project): about 1 GB, and 2.5 GB on this device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_SET_UP_DESCR.t: Aplikacije za Android se odprejo v svojih oknih ob drugih aplikacijah. Pri nastavitvi se prenese Android (LineageOS iz projekta Waydroid): približno 1 GB, v tej napravi pa zasede 2,5 GB.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.en: Android apps aren't available right now.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_UNAVAILABLE.t: Aplikacije za Android trenutno niso na voljo.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.en: Android uses SIZE on this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_ANDROID_USES.t: Sistem Android v tej napravi zaseda SIZE

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.en: See Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox and other cloud storage in Files
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DESCRIPTION.t: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox in druge shrambe v oblaku v aplikaciji Datoteke

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DONE.t: Račun ACCOUNT_NAME je zdaj v aplikaciji Datoteke.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.en: Google Drive needs your own client ID and secret from the Google Cloud console.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_DRIVE_HELP.t: Google Drive potrebuje vaš lasten ID odjemalca in skrivnost iz konzole Google Cloud.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_ENDPOINT.t: Končna točka (za Amazon S3 pustite prazno)

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.en: Couldn't connect. Check the details and try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_FAILED.t: Povezave ni bilo mogoče vzpostaviti. Preverite podatke in poskusite znova.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.en: NickelOS uses rclone to show your cloud storage in Files, so your files are easy to reach. Choose a service to sign in to.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_RCLONE.t: NickelOS z orodjem rclone prikaže shrambo v oblaku v aplikaciji Datoteke, da so vaše datoteke vedno pri roki. Izberite storitev, v katero se želite prijaviti.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.en: Files stops showing this account. Your files stay in the cloud, and you can add the account again later.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_REMOVE_BODY.t: Aplikacija Datoteke ne bo več prikazovala tega računa. Vaše datoteke ostanejo v oblaku, račun pa lahko pozneje znova dodate.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.en: Finish signing in on the page that opened in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGNING_IN.t: Dokončajte prijavo na strani, ki se je odprla v brskalniku.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.en: When you connect, the service's sign-in page opens in your browser.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_SIGN_IN_NOTE.t: Ko se povežete, se v brskalniku odpre stran za prijavo v storitev.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_CLOUD_TWO_FACTOR.t: Koda za preverjanje v dveh korakih (če jo uporabljate)

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.en: Only an administrator of this computer can change its name.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_ADMIN_.t: Ime tega računalnika lahko spremeni samo njegov skrbnik.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.en: Other devices see this name on your network and over Bluetooth, and the Terminal and Linux apps show it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_DIALOG.t: Druge naprave vidijo to ime v vašem omrežju in prek Bluetootha, prikazujejo pa ga tudi Terminal in aplikacije za Linux.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.en: The name couldn't be changed. Try again.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_FAILED.t: Imena ni bilo mogoče spremeniti. Poskusite znova.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.en: Use at least one letter from A to Z or a number.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_COMPUTER_NAME_INVALI.t: Uporabite vsaj eno črko od A do Z ali števko.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.en: The apps that open each kind of file, from Files and from Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_DESCRIP.t: Aplikacije, ki odpirajo posamezne vrste datotek iz aplikacije Datoteke in iz aplikacij za Linux

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DEFAULT_APPS_NONE.t: Nobena aplikacija ne odpre teh datotek

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.en: Drives inside this device besides the one with NickelOS. The drive that holds Windows opens read-only, so Windows stays intact.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVES_DESCRIPTION.t: Pogoni v tej napravi poleg tistega s sistemom NickelOS. Pogon s sistemom Windows se odpre samo za branje, tako da Windows ostane nedotaknjen.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.en: Windows is on this drive. It's read-only unless you allow changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_ALLOW_CHANGES_.t: Na tem pogonu je Windows. Če ne dovolite sprememb, je samo za branje.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.en: With Fast Startup, Windows doesn't fully shut down, and changes made here can be lost or damage files when Windows starts again. Turn off Fast Startup in Windows, or hold Shift while you shut Windows down, before you make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_BODY.t: S hitrim zagonom se Windows ne zaustavi povsem in spremembe, narejene tukaj, se lahko izgubijo ali poškodujejo datoteke, ko se Windows znova zažene. Preden naredite spremembe, v sistemu Windows izklopite hitri zagon ali med zaustavljanjem sistema Windows pridržite tipko Shift.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.en: Allow changes to the Windows drive?
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_DIALOG_TITLE.t: Želite dovoliti spremembe pogona s sistemom Windows?

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.en: Windows didn't shut down fully, so the drive stays read-only. Shut down Windows fully to make changes.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_DRIVE_HIBERNATED.t: Windows se ni povsem zaustavil, zato pogon ostane samo za branje. Če želite narediti spremembe, Windows povsem zaustavite.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.en: The forum, Discord and GitHub, on nickelos.dev
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_COMMUNITY_DESCR.t: Forum, Discord in GitHub na spletnem mestu nickelos.dev

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.en: Portage and emerge from the start, with pacman and apt commands side by side
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GENTOO_DESCRIPT.t: Portage in emerge od začetka, z vzporednimi ukazi za pacman in apt

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.en: How NickelOS works. This copy came with your version of NickelOS and works offline.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_GUIDE_DESCRIPTI.t: Kako deluje NickelOS. Ta kopija je bila priložena vaši različici sistema NickelOS in deluje tudi brez povezave.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_MENU_ITEM_DESCR.t: Vodnik, učenje sistema Gentoo, odpravljanje težav

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_ONLINE_DESCRIPT.t: Najnovejša različica na spletnem mestu nickelos.dev

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.en: Logs, crash reports, and the usual problems and their fixes
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_HELP_TROUBLESHOOTING.t: Dnevniki, poročila o zrušitvah ter pogoste težave in njihove rešitve

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.en: With the KDE Connect app on Android or iPhone, on the same Wi‑Fi network
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_DESCRIPTION.t: Z aplikacijo KDE Connect za Android ali iPhone v istem omrežju Wi‑Fi

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.en: No phones or tablets yet. Install KDE Connect from Google Play, F‑Droid or the App Store, open it on the same Wi‑Fi network, then pair from either device.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NONE.t: Ni še telefonov ali tabličnih računalnikov. Namestite KDE Connect iz trgovine Google Play, F‑Droid ali App Store, ga odprite v istem omrežju Wi‑Fi in nato začnite seznanjanje v kateri koli od naprav.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.en: The phone connection isn't running. Sign out and back in to start it.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_NOT_RUNNING.t: Povezava s telefoni ne deluje. Za zagon se odjavite in znova prijavite.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.en: Wants to pair with this device
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_PHONES_WANTS_TO_PAIR.t: Želi se seznaniti s to napravo

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.en: Lets apps such as Discord use push-to-talk while you're in other windows. They see keys pressed with Ctrl, Alt or Search and function keys, never what you type.
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_DESCRIPTION.t: Aplikacijam, kot je Discord, omogoča uporabo funkcije »pritisni in govori«, ko ste v drugih oknih. Vidijo samo tipke, pritisnjene skupaj s Ctrl, Alt ali tipko za iskanje, in funkcijske tipke, nikoli pa tega, kar tipkate.

IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.en: Shortcut keys for older Linux apps
IDS_SETTINGS_NICKEL_X11_KEYS_LABEL.t: Bližnjične tipke v starejših aplikacijah za Linux

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.en: Make sure your printer is connected to the same Wi-Fi network as your NickelOS device or use a USB cable. LINK_BEGINLearn more about compatibilityLINK_END
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_HELP_SECTION_.t: Poskrbite, da je tiskalnik povezan v isto omrežje Wi-Fi kot naprava s sistemom NickelOS, ali uporabite kabel USB. LINK_BEGINPreberite več o združljivostiLINK_END.

IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.en: Can’t connect to printer. Check that the printer is turned on and is connected to your NickelOS device by Wi-Fi or USB.
IDS_SETTINGS_PRINTING_CUPS_PRINTER_ADDED.t: Ni se mogoče povezati s tiskalnikom. Preverite, ali je tiskalnik vklopljen in povezan z napravo s sistemom NickelOS prek omrežja Wi-Fi ali z USB-jem.

IDS_SETTINGS_SECURE_DNS_OPEN_CHROME_OS_S.en: Manage secure DNS in NickelOS settings
IDS_SETTINGS_SECURE_DNS_OPEN_CHROME_OS_S.t: Upravljanje varnega DNS-ja v nastavitvah sistema NickelOS

IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.en: To get started, please make sure your USB or Bluetooth switch is connected to your NickelOS device. You can also use keyboard keys.
IDS_SETTINGS_SWITCH_ACCESS_SETUP_INTRO_B.t: Če želite začeti, mora biti stikalo USB ali Bluetooth povezano z napravo s sistemom NickelOS. Uporabljate lahko tudi tipke na tipkovnici.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, make sure your phone's Bluetooth is on
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_LOOKING_FOR_PHONE.t: Če želite odkleniti napravo s sistemom NickelOS, mora biti vklopljen Bluetooth v telefonu.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.en: Your NickelOS device’s Bluetooth is off. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_BLUETOOTH.t: Bluetooth v napravi s sistemom NickelOS je izklopljen. Če želite odkleniti napravo, vnesite geslo.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.en: Your phone doesn’t have a lock screen. To unlock your NickelOS device, enter password.
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_NO_PHONE_LOCK_SCREE.t: Telefon nima zaklepanja zaslona. Če želite odkleniti napravo s sistemom NickelOS, vnesite geslo.

IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.en: To unlock your NickelOS device, first unlock your phone
IDS_SMART_LOCK_LABEL_PHONE_LOCKED.t: Če želite odkleniti napravo s sistemom NickelOS, najprej odklenite telefon.

IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.en: Your device uses a built-in sensor to detect people in front of it. All data is processed on your device immediately and then deleted. Sensor data is never sent to Google.
IDS_SMART_PRIVACY_PROTECTION_CONTENT.t: Vaša naprava uporablja vgrajeno tipalo za zaznavanje oseb pred njo. Vsi podatki so v napravi takoj obdelani in nato izbrisani. Podatki tipal niso nikoli poslani Googlu.

IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.en: NickelOS could not sync your data due to an error signing in.
IDS_SYNC_OTHER_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW.t: NickelOS ni mogel sinhronizirati podatkov zaradi napake pri prijavi.

IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because your account sign-in details are out of date.
IDS_SYNC_SIGN_IN_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_MESSA.t: NickelOS ni mogel sinhronizirati podatkov, ker so podatki za prijavo v račun zastareli.

IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.en: NickelOS could not sync your data because Sync is not available for your domain.
IDS_SYNC_UNAVAILABLE_ERROR_BUBBLE_VIEW_M.t: NickelOS ni mogel sinhronizirati podatkov, ker sinhronizacija ni na voljo za vašo domeno.

IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.en: MANAGER requires that you read and accept the following Terms of Service before using this device. These terms do not expand, modify or limit the NickelOS Terms.
IDS_TERMS_OF_SERVICE_SCREEN_SUBHEADING.t: MANAGER zahteva, da preberete in sprejmete pogoje storitve, preden začnete uporabljati napravo. Ti pogoji ne dopolnjujejo, spreminjajo ali omejujejo pogojev za NickelOS.

IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.en: NickelOS needs to be restarted to apply the update.
IDS_UPDATE_RECOMMENDED.t: Če želite uveljaviti posodobitev, morate znova zagnati NickelOS.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.en: You’ll sign in to your device with your own account, and everyone who uses it can have one.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TEXT.t: V napravo se boste prijavili s svojim računom, svoj račun pa ima lahko vsak, ki jo uporablja.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.en: Your own account on your device
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ACCOUNT_TITLE.t: V napravo se prijavite s svojim računom

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.en: NickelOS is designed with security in mind, and it keeps itself up to date automatically.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_ANTIVIRUS_TEXT.t: NickelOS je zasnovan z mislijo na varnost in se samodejno posodablja.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.en: NickelOS runs web apps and Linux apps side by side. Get apps for productivity, entertainment, and more.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_APPS_TEXT.t: NickelOS izvaja spletne aplikacije in aplikacije za Linux drugo ob drugi. Prenesite aplikacije za storilnost, razvedrilo in drugo.

IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.en: This is the only time you’ll wait for an update. On NickelOS, software updates happen in the background.
IDS_UPDATE_SLIDE_UPDATE_TEXT.t: Samo tokrat boste čakali na posodobitev. V sistemu NickelOS se posodobitve programske opreme izvajajo v ozadju.

IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.en: Chrome apps don’t run on NickelOS. Consider an alternative app.
IDS_USER_INSTALLED_CHROME_APP_DEPRECATIO.t: Aplikacije za Chrome ne delujejo v sistemu NickelOS. Uporabite drugo aplikacijo.

IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.en: Unfortunately, your computer is configured with a malformed hardware ID. This prevents NickelOS from updating with the latest security fixes and your computer BEGIN_BOLDmay be vulnerable to malicious attacksEND_BOLD.
IDS_WRONG_HWID_SCREEN_MESSAGE_FIRST_PART.t: Vaš računalnik je konfiguriran s popačenim ID-jem strojne opreme. Zaradi tega NickelOS ne more namestiti najnovejših varnostnih popravkov in vaš računalnik BEGIN_BOLDje lahko še bolj izpostavljen zlonamernim napadomEND_BOLD.
